meta.title: Skill Shelf
meta.description: Browse, search and switch every local skill from one panel: Settings → Skill Shelf (General / Workspace / Market / Evolution / Trash), or the 960 px sidebar panel (the sidebar entry can be turned off in settings). Each row shows day / week / total call counts and success rate from an append-only local ledger at ~/.dsh/skill-usage-manager/usage-ledger.jsonl that survives session deletion; the rate is recorded from each call's actual result, and calls with no recorded result show as unknown rather than 0%. The General tab groups by directory, role, invocation or as a flat list; roles come from keyword rules over each skill's name and description, and the view honours the status filter like the others. The per-row model / user invocation switches write back to that skill's SKILL.md frontmatter in place, so the recorded install time is never disturbed. Installs are content-audited first (hidden control characters, pipe-to-shell, credential paths); GitHub sources keep a commit pin, an update check and a restorable trash (expand for the note), and diagnostics locate and repair loading problems. The Evolution tab mines proposals from session history with an occurrence probability, logs every decision to a ledger, and after human review applies them into the owning project workspace. Only ~/.dsh/skills and ~/.agents/skills are writable, and every toggle is a sidecar override, so skill source files never change. Pure local: no model calls; it contacts GitHub and skills.sh only for the checks and installs you start, and turning the plugin off removes the panel, the routes and the system-prompt note.
